selection.summary: Migrated post raw/summary data access from socket methods to Write API. Added postsAPI.getRawPost and postsAPI.getSummary in src/api/posts.js replicating the legacy socket access-control logic (topics:read privilege check, deleted-post rejection, filter:post.getRawPost hook; topic privileges + modifyPostByPrivilege for summaries). Added Posts.getRawPost/Posts.getSummary controllers in src/controllers/write/posts.js and registered GET /:pid/raw and GET /:pid/summary routes in src/routes/write/posts.js. Removed SocketPosts.getRawPost and SocketPosts.getPostSummaryByPid from src/socket.io/posts.js. Updated the two client call sites (public/src/client/topic/postTools.js, public/src/client/topic.js) to use api.get against the new v3 endpoints instead of socket.emit. Evidence covers the legacy socket method implementations, the API/controller/route surfaces modified, and the client callers whose behavior and access controls were preserved.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles plus at most one presented, provenance-valid adjacent test read for a selected same-stem implementation source; native source projection and export unchanged.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
